title: Loop+ Plan Courtesy on Marketplace Orders Replacement Charges
content:
**Rule.** The plan courtesy of the Marketplace Orders replacement charge looks at the buyer's Loop+ membership: a membership in good standing (trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending) on an annual plan (Loop+ Annual, Loop+ Household Annual, Loop+ Student Annual) earns the annual courtesy rate of 0.1 (10%); a membership in good standing on a monthly plan (Loop+ Access Monthly, Loop+ Student Monthly, Loop+ Monthly) earns the monthly courtesy rate of 0.05 (5%); any other buyer earns no plan courtesy.

The Loop+ courtesy of the replacement charge is the plan courtesy rate plus any other Loop+ courtesy rate the membership earns on the charge, applied once to the charged item amount and rounded half up to the cent; it is deducted from the replacement charge.

The record read is the buyer's Loop+ Membership: its status and its plan.

## Rate by status and plan

| Membership status | Plan | Plan courtesy rate |
|---|---|---|
| trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending | Loop+ Annual, Loop+ Household Annual, Loop+ Student Annual | 10% |
| trial, active, payment hold or cancel pending | Loop+ Access Monthly, Loop+ Student Monthly, Loop+ Monthly | 5% |
| pending, lapsed or cancelled | any | none |
| no membership | — | none |

### Hypothetical case

A buyer on Loop+ Household Annual in active status, with a charged item amount of USD 36.00 and no other courtesy rate, has a Loop+ courtesy of 10% of 36.00, that is USD 3.60, deducted from the charge.
